# FARFETCH

> FARFETCH is the global destination for modern luxury fashion, connecting customers with over 100,000 designer styles from brands like Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, Maison Margiela, and PUCCI.

FARFETCH operates as a luxury fashion marketplace offering designer clothing, footwear, and accessories for men, women, and kids across multiple regions. The platform features exclusive collaborations, new season collections, and sports luxe athleisure alongside traditional luxury brands, with services including express delivery and free returns.

## Platform Overview

- [FARFETCH | The Global Destination For Modern Luxury](https://www.farfetch.com): FARFETCH homepage: luxury fashion marketplace with 100,000+ designer styles
- [FARFETCH United Arab Emirates | The Global Destination for Modern Luxury](https://www.farfetch.com/ae): FARFETCH UAE regional homepage with Prada, Gucci & Versace collections
- [FARFETCH - The Global Destination For Modern Luxury](https://www.farfetch.com/ao/boutiques): Partner boutiques directory featuring 10 Corso Como Milan and luxury stores
